vibe_title_en: AAA Narrative 2D Splash Art (Arkane Narrative Edition V7)
master_prompt: A cinematic, ultra high-detail 2D narrative splash art illustration of {subject}, executed primarily in the visual language of Arkane Studios character promotional art, Dishonored character portraits, and painterly narrative concept art. Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). Use dynamic asymmetrical composition (Rule of Thirds), positioning the character to one side to reveal narrative elements in the environment. Construct all anatomy through sculptural facial planes, value masses, visible painterly brushwork, and strong shape design. Character identity, facial architecture, and narrative presence must take priority over glamour, beauty standards, fashion-model aesthetics, decorative rendering, and visual excess. The face must function as the unquestionable focal center of the image. Detail density, contrast, edge sharpness, and rendering fidelity must progressively dissolve as distance from the face increases.

meta.intent: Narrative RPG splash art with Arkane Studios visual DNA

distribution.accent_10: Eyes, jewelry, magical effects, focal symbols

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

composition_system.layout: Extended full-body, Hips fully visible, legs and feet fully and always visible, all body parts always visible
composition_system.balance: Narrative counterweight on opposite side of character

rules: The face receives the overwhelming majority of rendering resources
The viewer's eye must immediately lock onto the face
No secondary element may compete with the face
Visual complexity must progressively decay as distance from the face increases
The image should feel painted outward from the face
Detail concentration must remain heavily centralized
Detail density progressively dissolves away from the face
Peripheral anatomy may simplify into painterly forms
Visual suggestion is preferred over exhaustive description
Use larger brushstrokes outside focal regions
Lost-and-found edges increase with distance from the face
Peripheral forms should merge into larger value masses
Painterly abstraction is preferred over hyper-rendering
The viewer should perceive complete anatomy even when individual details are not fully rendered
Abstraction should appear intentional and artistic rather than blurry

detail_sacrifice_hierarchy.rule: Whenever image complexity increases, detail must be removed from lower-priority elements before reducing quality in higher-priority elements.
